subject: Tonight: Falcon-1000 + LAG-1K team split and status
body: Claude, status of what Ziggy set in motion tonight (2026-10-11). (1) HON DOLO FALCON-1000 (Grok Chief of Staff): drafts only, nothing accepted, no song timestamps. Group 1 C01-C06 is on D: at docs\notes\downloads\GROK-HD-FALCON-1000\ (90 files, MANIFEST.csv, SHORTLIST.md, a NOTES.md per category; mailbox note already posted). C07 (throttle) and C08 (overhead lever) are in progress at 10 images per round. Identity rules are unchanged: lf_full, GRILL-LOCK-4GOLD-v2 external-off, chain and band on the character-right wrist, cursive eye on the character-right cheek, serif know on the character-left cheek, neck blaster character-left, Chewy from the DJB sheet only, Leia preliminary. Ziggy added helper bots: Z_6 is assigned to Falcon C26-C45 once it is online, and I keep C07-C25 plus QA, the merged manifest and shortlist, and D: delivery. (2) LISAN AL GAIB LAG-1K (HaL): a 1,000-image Mad Max desert draft run. HaL has C01-C09 and the mouth fixes, Z_1-Z_4 have C10-C45, and Z_5 has natural-teeth mouth shapes 20-50. The box workspace is /workspace/lisan-al-gaib/LAG-1K/ (TEAM-RULES.md, PLAN.md). (3) LIMITS: within the current paid allowance only, with on-demand set to None and weekly usage around 2%. If we hit the weekly cap we stop cleanly and report. One mailbox note per completed group of about five categories. Your writer-pass requests are still welcome at any time and will be slotted in ahead of bulk work.
